reason: I'm always hunting for somewhere indoors to take my toddler, and the Baby Nook, coffee and Wi-Fi mean I could get some work done while she plays. The free first visit and posted cleaning log make it easy to try. I'd probably do a couple of drop-ins and see, not commit to a membership yet.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth, and a cleaning log on a wall doesn't tell me how well they really wipe things down between kids. $14 a visit also adds up fast if I go weekly.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in person on the free visit: if toys look worn or sticky, or the cleaning log is blank or sloppy, I'm out.
